service.name: Jazz band for a wedding
service.serviceType: Jazz band for wedding ceremonies, cocktail hours, dinners and receptions in Colorado
service.description: A jazz band for a Colorado wedding, sized to each part of the day: a solo jazz guitarist or a duo for the ceremony, upright bass and guitar through the cocktail hour, a trio with brushes through dinner, and a quartet with a horn or a voice for the first dance and the floor, on one contract with sound included, across Denver, the Front Range and the mountain towns.

faqs.q: Which size of jazz band does a wedding reception need?
faqs.a: It depends on what the floor is doing. Dinner wants the trio, drums played with brushes. A first dance and an open floor want the quartet, the trio plus a horn or a voice, and a ballroom of two hundred wants the quartet with a singer out front. Tell us the guest count and the venue and we'll recommend the size. Signet Artists books wedding jazz bands across Denver and the Colorado mountains.

At the ceremony and through the cocktail hour, gentle enough that guests greet each other over it; at dinner, the level of the conversation at the table; on the floor, the quartet plays like a dance band, up to what the venue allows.

faqs.q: Will a jazz band play our first dance?
faqs.a: Yes. If the song is a standard, it's already in the repertoire, and if it isn't, one learned song comes with every booking. Send the title with the date.

faqs.q: Is a jazz band the right choice for a wedding that wants dancing?
faqs.a: For a floor that wants to dance to songs it knows, a jazz quartet plays the swing and the soul side of the standards book and hands off to the DJ for the late end. For a floor that wants pop and rock all night, book a covers band for the reception and keep the jazz for the ceremony, the cocktail hour and dinner, on the same contract.
